what.text: This page follows refugees from South Sudan living in Egypt, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 26954 South Sudanese refugees in Egypt, 1.1% of all refugees from South Sudan.
Uganda hosts the most South Sudanese refugees, followed by Sudan, Ethiopia and Kenya.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of South Sudan from 2011 to 2021, with the SPLM/A - IO among the opponents, and again in 2025.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between South Sudan and Sudan in 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2012 at 178 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2019 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Egypt.
These are year-end totals for Egypt only, reported to UNHCR.
